title: depends_on starts the app before the database accepts connections, so first boot fails
symptoms: ECONNREFUSED or 'the database system is starting up' on first docker compose up, gone after a restart
The app container exits while the db container shows as running
cause: The short depends_on form waits only until the dependency container is running, not until the process inside it is ready.
fix: Give the dependency a healthcheck and use the long depends_on form with condition service_healthy.
apply:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U postgres"]
      interval: 2s
      retries: 30
  app:
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
affected: Docker Compose v2, as of October 2026
